name: get_flow_health
title: Flow health
description:
How one flow has been doing lately: runs started in a recent window, how they ended, how many are still going,
how many conversations they covered and rehearsals left out.
Runs are counted by the UTC date they started. `waiting` is a subset of running, and a running run is normally
waiting for a customer, not stuck. Today is partial.

days.description: UTC days back, ending with today. At most 90.
